title: Experiment for: Decrease Safety Margin
rationale: Candidate task.policy.safety_margin=0.1: Expected Improvement=0.50, Info Gain=1.00, Prior Influence=No direct prior bias. Mechanism: The safety margin is a buffer zone that the robot maintains around obstacles to ensure safe navigation. Decreasing this margin can make the robot more aggressive in its path planning.
expected_outcome: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to come closer to obstacles, potentially increasing its speed and efficiency, but at the risk of more frequent collisions.
